proposed_nodes.label: Coherent high-order accuracy-ablation ladder
proposed_nodes.summary: A target-free preregistration fixes a nested A0 full, A1 CP4-off, A2 third-only, A3 CP3-only ladder. Adjacent contrasts isolate CP4 history, coherent H4+alpha/L4, and H3 without K31-only or other inconsistent planes.
proposed_nodes.terminal_criterion: After V3 passes runtime and moment gates, byte-freeze and meter every activated arm, then resolve all adjacent final/all-layer/per-layer raw-MSE contrasts in one fixed roster.

proposed_nodes.label: CP3 frozen anchor and conditional same-host necessity control
proposed_nodes.summary: Bind the sealed Gaussian/Hermite versus cap-16384 CP3 evidence. Open a same-host Gaussian control only if CP3-only is worse than the frozen Gaussian anchor or the H3 contrast is directionally inconsistent; remove CP3 as a whole with no K3 side channel.
proposed_nodes.terminal_criterion: Either accept the frozen CP3 anchor as sufficient separation or resolve one preregistered same-host CP3-versus-Gaussian contrast without rank or coefficient variants.

proposed_nodes.label: CP4 history versus memoryless coherent quartic residual
proposed_nodes.summary: Compare full V3 only against CP4-off with H4+alpha absorbing the same complete corrected quartic reset; the contrast isolates the complete CP4 carrier/tensor-completion history, including dense-ray retention, birth, top-energy truncation, and stored-float32 rounding.
proposed_nodes.terminal_criterion: Resolve whether CP4 history improves the fixed local raw-MSE trajectory or reverses late, with exact literal meter deltas and no cap sweep.

proposed_nodes.label: Coherent H4+alpha and L4 contribution
proposed_nodes.summary: Compare CP4-off against a third-only closure that removes H4+alpha and L4 together but retains half L3-squared; compute only M11/M21.
proposed_nodes.terminal_criterion: Resolve the complete coherent fourth-order package without interpreting any K31-only deletion.

proposed_nodes.label: H3 residual versus CP3-only third state
proposed_nodes.summary: Compare third-only against CP3-only by removing H3 as a whole and specializing the pair consumer to M11; the contrast isolates reset-complete K21 residual transport.
proposed_nodes.terminal_criterion: Resolve whether H3's coordinate-star continuation helps or injects all-distinct bias, preserving cap-16384 CP3 unchanged.

proposed_nodes.label: Conditional half-L3-squared consumer ablation
proposed_nodes.summary: On the unique best A0-A3 carrier only, compare the full consumer against coherent first-order-in-cumulants 1+L3+L4 by deleting all seven order-six pair channels and univariate K3-squared terms.
proposed_nodes.terminal_criterion: Run exactly once if the primary carrier ladder remains above 1e-8; do not tune the coefficient.

proposed_nodes.label: Actual-moment feasibility gate
proposed_nodes.summary: Run the actual post-Edgeworth univariate Stieltjes/Hankel diagnostic target-free on every activated carrier, with no scalar clipping or target-conditioned repair.
proposed_nodes.terminal_criterion: Every arm admitted to the score roster has a finite, passing actual-moment feasibility receipt, or is rejected before any target open.

proposed_nodes.label: Q24-Q32 numerical-order separation
proposed_nodes.summary: Target-free replay changes only rho-power truncation from Q32 to Q24 while retaining Q38 features and all 17 channels; score Q24 only if prediction disagreement or feasibility changes materially.
proposed_nodes.terminal_criterion: Record state/output disagreement and exact literal meter delta; either exonerate Q32 order or activate one Q24 score arm, never a sweep.

proposed_nodes.label: PSD repair intervention and lawful comparator
proposed_nodes.summary: Measure raw-to-repaired correlation intervention at every reset. Because PSD-off is incoherent, compare at most once with the fixed diagonal-preserving correlation-ridge law if intervention is material.
proposed_nodes.terminal_criterion: Exonerate negligible repair or resolve spectral clip versus the single frozen lawful ridge comparator; no floor sweep or indefinite rollout.

proposed_nodes.label: Fixed-roster pure-closure scoring and promotion
proposed_nodes.summary: After source, literal-meter, runtime, finiteness, and actual-moment gates pass, freeze A0-A3 as one roster for a single authorized local target open; build conditional A4 only after the unique winner is selected by the preregistered rule.
proposed_nodes.terminal_criterion: Promote only a source-bound, independently audited arm with an exact Phase-2 receipt and held raw MSE below 1e-8; otherwise preserve all fixed-roster causal results and leave P2R0H blocked.

blocking_condition: Final V3 parent has not yet passed all source, meter, finiteness, and actual-moment gates.
